record.oneLiner: Aircall is a cloud-based phone system and call center software platform providing a public REST API for managing calls, contacts, users, teams, and SMS integrations.
record.verdictReason: Aircall provides a comprehensive REST API and allows independent developers to generate self-serve API keys directly from the dashboard. Community MCP servers are also available.

evidence.quote: Aircall supports two ways to authenticate with the REST API: Basic Authentication and OAuth.
1. Open your Aircall Dashboard. 2. Go to Integrations > API Keys page. 3. Under API Keys, click Generate API key. 4. Copy your API ID and API Token.
MCP Server for Aircall API — 73 tools for calls, contacts, SMS, users, teams, transcripts, AI summaries, and more.
